Definition: Nathan, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Nathan = "giver"; 1) a son of David by Bathsheba; 2) the eminent prophet in the time of David and Solomon; 3) a man of Zobah, father of one of David's mighty warriors; 4) father of Azariah who was over the officers of Solomon; 5) son of Attai and father of Zabad of the tribe of Judah; 6) brother of Joel of the tribe of Judah; 7) one of the head men who returned from Babylon with Ezra; 8) a man with a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 9) head of a family of Israel who shall mourn when they look on Him whom they pierced
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
